label: Our Story
paragraphs: From The Heart (FTH), a church commissioned by God, empowered by God and lead by God was birth out of a group of believers who met on Saturday evenings in a garage for bible study.

It was a season of healing, prayer, and sharing of testimonies. After 9 months, Pastor George and Sister Deb decided to disband the group and to seek God's wisdom for which path they should follow regarding ministry.

During the month of June 2011 after much prayer, fasting and soul-searching Pastor George and Sister Deb along with a group of 4 which grew to 28 people decided to plant From The Heart Church, a church where the word of God would be proclaimed in applicable way, people would live lives of character and integrity, worship without question, would be Spirit-lead and Spirit-filled.
From The Heart Church would be Real, Raw and Relevant, a church for everyone, a church committed to loving God, loving people, healing the hurting, restoring the fractured, living kingdom lives.

On November 13, 2011, FTH held its first Sunday service in the gym of Ken-O-Sha Elementary. Fifty-two people walked through the doors and God did exceedingly and abundantly above that FTH could ask for or think.

Since 2011, God's providential hand has guided FTH to two different locations. 904 36th St. in 2015 and our present location 1090 36th St. in 2018. Through it all FTH continues to be a House of God, full of biblical preaching, Spirit-filled worship and genuine heartfelt fellowship for anyone who walks through the doors.
pullquote: Loving God. Loving people. Healing the hurting. Restoring the fractured. Living Kingdom lives.
